BackstoryDef.title: famine child
BackstoryDef.baseDescription: [PAWN_nameDef] was small when the famine came to the Ratkin settlements. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to search refuse for food and to distrust anyone promising a full meal.

BackstoryDef.title: relief trader
BackstoryDef.baseDescription: [PAWN_nameDef] moved food and medicine between Ratkin settlements during the famine. [PAWN_pronoun] learned which promises could be traded and which ones would leave a caravan empty.
